canonical_title: Ecological State at a Temporal Cut: Sparse Semantic Access
state_concept: state is the least information that must survive an observational temporal cut under a declared scientific contract
headline: semantic prerequisite order and semantic access coverage are distinct state-construction objects
headline_quantity: state quotients are computed from companion semantic classes, semantic access relations, legal future traces, and induced equivalence
modeling_contribution: identify which ecological interfaces a future target minimally requires and on which semantic combinations of those interfaces the target is actually addressable
novelty_boundary: CREST does not claim novelty for quotient state abstraction, Mobius/Harsanyi accounting, unanimity games, or finite counting once the access relation is fixed. The contribution is the temporal-cut modeling architecture, strict companion realizability boundaries, semantic companion composition, and explicit separation of prerequisite order from semantic access coverage.

realizability_boundaries.fixed_partition_bound: fixed precomputed partitions on a one-class baseline cannot generate positive interaction by common refinement alone
realizability_boundaries.immutable_history_no_activation: a zero-debt post-cut audit preserving raw MLTR history cannot become nontrivial by rewriting the past
realizability_boundaries.fixed_grammar_mrm_zero_debt: candidate-safe zero debt under one fixed grammar implies a singleton MRM response type

semantic_companions.history: CREST consumes complete MLTR carried maps and quotients raw routes by equality of carried semantics
semantic_companions.latent_response: CREST quotients primitive MRM candidate laws by equality of complete declared response tables
semantic_companions.future: CCOC future responsibility is a declared legal query grammar

sparse_semantic_access.interpretation: prerequisite order fixes the interaction order; semantic coverage changes its magnitude

canonical_numeric_witness.claim_boundary: finite semantic-access witness, not an empirical ecological constant

complete_access_boundary.status: v0.6 full-addressability boundary case, not canonical v0.7 witness

shallow_lake_prerequisite_audit.status: executable literature-grounded finite decision model, not empirical validation
shallow_lake_prerequisite_audit.validation: minimum prerequisite sets are computed by target factorization and counterfactual interface substitution

literature_positioning.bisimulation_and_state_abstraction: Givan, Dean, and Greig 2003; Li, Walsh, and Littman 2006
